resumeText:
Riya Agarwal | Jaipur, Rajasthan | riya.agarwal26@example.com

EDUCATION
B.Com (Honours), Accounting and Finance, St. Anselm's College of Commerce, Jaipur (2023 - 2026) | CGPA 8.4/10
Class XII (Commerce), CBSE, 2023 | 91%

INTERNSHIPS
Audit and Accounts Intern, Mehta Jain & Associates (Chartered Accountants), Jaipur (May 2025 - Jul 2025, 10 weeks)
- Recorded 400+ purchase and sales vouchers in Tally Prime for two trading clients.
- Prepared GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B working sheets for 12 small-business clients and matched them with the GST portal.
- Prepared bank reconciliation statements for three client accounts and flagged unmatched entries to the senior.

Accounts Intern, Pinkcity Handloom Exports, Jaipur (Dec 2024 - Jan 2025, 6 weeks)
- Entered vendor invoices and sorted pending supplier bills by due date for the accounts manager.
- Filed purchase orders and goods receipt notes for the monthly audit file.

ACADEMIC PROJECTS
- Final accounts (Financial Accounting II): Prepared the trial balance, trading account, profit and loss account and balance sheet for a sample partnership firm from 60 journal entries.
- Research project: Surveyed 45 kirana shop owners in Jaipur on how GST registration changed their billing habits and wrote a 20-page report.

CERTIFICATIONS AND COURSEWORK
- Tally Prime with GST, Rajasthan Commerce Academy (2024)
- Coursework: Financial Accounting, Corporate Accounting, Income Tax Law, Auditing, Business Statistics

SKILLS
Tally Prime, GST returns, Accounts payable and receivable, Bank reconciliation, MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables), MS Word

ACTIVITIES
- Treasurer, Commerce Society (2024 - 2025)
- NSS volunteer, financial literacy camps in nearby villages
